O.content: The blue circular mark above "Design" is visibly higher on the page than the marks above Quality, Price, Support, Delivery, and Other.

B.text: If the vertical positions of the plotted markers encode the current rating-share values on the y-axis labeled "Value," then the highest marker corresponds to the greatest value and should be selected under the promotion rule.

B.text: If the percentage inscriptions attached to each category's plotted mark are the dashboard's current labeled rating-share values, then compare those inscriptions across all shown categories and select the category with the greatest value; the task policy assigns additional promotional budget to that category.
